response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT c.country AS country, cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS gained FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), ca AS (SELECT country, AVG(gained) AS avg_w FROM d GROUP BY country), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_w) AS mean1 FROM ca), a AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_w, ca.avg_w - m1.mean1 AS ex1 FROM ca, m1 WHERE ca.avg_w > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_w) AS mean2 FROM a), b AS (SELECT a.country, a.avg_w, a.ex1, a.avg_w - m2.mean2 AS ex2 FROM a, m2 WHERE a.avg_w > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_w) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(ex1) AS mean_excess_over_all_mean, AVG(ex2) AS mean_excess_over_group_mean FROM b
